verdicts.note: Exists: Violin Concerto No. 7 in D major, K. 271a (3rd ed.) = K. 271i (6th ed.), the 'Kolb' concerto, c.1777; attribution disputed (Einstein judged some solo passages 19th-c. additions), so '(doubtful)' is right. First published 1907 Breitkopf & Haertel; IMSLP gives ~28 min. Optional style tweak: Koechel-6 number first, i.e. 'K. 271i (271a)', to match the existing 'K. 269 (261a)'.

IMSLP: Violin Sonata in A major, K.402/385e, 2 movements (Andante, ma un poco adagio; fugue Allegro moderato), incomplete; fugue completed by Maximilian Stadler (Mozart's holograph lost). Editions: Breitkopf Mozarts Werke XVIII (1879), Peters, Baerenreiter NMA VIII/23 (1965); Henle 'Violin Sonatas - Fragments' volume prints it. Cf. Baerenreiter/Henle title 'Andante and Fugue in A, K. 402'.

IMSLP: Violin Sonata in C major, K.403/385c, 3 movements (Allegro moderato, Andante, Allegretto), incomplete: Mozart's finale breaks off at bar 20, completion by Stadler. First published c.1826/27 (Andre); Breitkopf 1879, Peters 1912, NMA VIII/23 (1965). Henle's Fragments volume prints Stadler's and R. Levin's completions.

IMSLP: Violin Sonata in C major, K.46d, 1768, 3 movements (Allegro; Menuet I; Menuet II), scored violin and basso (cello); only edition Baerenreiter NMA VIII/21 (1975, ed. Berke/Flothuis). Accompaniment 'Continuo' is acceptable. Companion K.46e (N18) confirmed the same way. Only 3 short movements, so 8 min looks long (about 5).

IMSLP: Allegro in B-flat major, K.372 (1781), one incomplete movement (Mozart's fragment ends bar 65), completion by Stadler. Editions: Breitkopf Mozarts Werke XVIII (1879), Baerenreiter NMA VIII/23 (1965); also in Henle's Violin Sonatas - Fragments volume (listed as 'Sonata movement in B-flat major, K. 372').

verdicts.title: Concerto in D major, K. Anh. 294a 'Adélaïde' (spurious, by Casadesus)
verdicts.note: Exists, but SPURIOUS: written by Marius Casadesus, published 1933 (Schott, Mainz, per BnF) as an arrangement of a 'Mozart' manuscript; Casadesus admitted authorship in 1977. Catalogue numbers: K. Anh. 294a (Koechel 3) = K. Anh. C 14.05 (Koechel 6). Recorded by Menuhin (Paris SO/Monteux). Title only restyled to house form (nickname in single quotes, no extra parentheses). Brief's rule would reject spurious works; kept because the owner's hint lists Anh. 294a - drop if spurious works are unwanted.

gaps.scoring: violin and keyboard (6 sonatas: F, C, C, E-flat, C minor, E minor)
gaps.edition: Breitkopf & Härtel, Mozarts Werke Serie XVIII (1879); IMSLP
